sentences.english: Whose bag is this?
sentences.chinese: 这个包是谁的？
sentences.scene: 在教室看到一个无人认领的书包

sentences.english: Do you know whose phone is ringing? I think it's coming from the sofa.
sentences.chinese: 你知道是谁的手机在响吗？好像是从沙发那边传来的。
sentences.scene: 家里听到陌生铃声，大家互相询问

sentences.english: I found a really nice jacket on the bus, and now I'm trying to figure out whose it is by asking around the office.
sentences.chinese: 我在公交车上捡到一件很不错的夹克，现在正试着在办公室到处问，看是谁的。
sentences.scene: 失物招领时的努力寻找

sentences.english: I like your sweater.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢你的毛衣。
sentences.scene: 朋友见面时随口称赞

sentences.english: It's cold outside, so don't forget to wear a sweater under your coat.
sentences.chinese: 外面冷，别忘了在外套里面穿件毛衣。
sentences.scene: 妈妈在孩子出门前叮嘱

sentences.english: My grandma knitted this sweater for me when I was in high school, and it's still the warmest and softest thing I own.
sentences.chinese: 这件毛衣是我奶奶在我上高中时给我织的，它至今仍是我最暖和、最柔软的衣服。
sentences.scene: 穿着充满回忆的温暖毛衣

sentences.english: I lost one sock.
sentences.chinese: 我丢了一只袜子。
sentences.scene: 叠衣服时发现袜子不成对

sentences.english: Where are my socks? I can't find a clean pair anywhere.
sentences.chinese: 我的袜子在哪儿？我到处都找不到一双干净的。
sentences.scene: 匆忙准备出门时翻找抽屉

sentences.english: After the long hike in the rain, my socks were so wet and muddy that I just threw them away before getting into the car.
sentences.chinese: 雨中长途徒步后，我的袜子又湿又全是泥，我上车前直接把它们扔掉了。
sentences.scene: 户外冒险后狼狈地处理脏袜子

sentences.english: That book is mine.
sentences.chinese: 那本书是我的。
sentences.scene: 在桌上看到自己的书时声明

sentences.english: Is this your phone? No, mine is bigger and has a red case.
sentences.chinese: 这是你的手机吗？不，我的更大，还有个红色的壳。
sentences.scene: 朋友拿错手机时澄清

sentences.english: Your drawing is really good, but mine looks like a five-year-old made it, even though I tried my best.
sentences.chinese: 你的画真好，但我的看起来就像五岁小孩画的，尽管我已经尽力了。
sentences.scene: 比较画作时自嘲

sentences.english: What should I wear today?
sentences.chinese: 我今天该穿什么？
sentences.scene: 早晨站在衣柜前发愁

sentences.english: You should wear a hat because it's really sunny outside.
sentences.chinese: 你应该戴顶帽子，外面太阳特别大。
sentences.scene: 出门前家人互相提醒

sentences.english: I decided to wear my favorite dress to the party even though it was a bit too fancy, because it makes me feel really confident.
sentences.chinese: 我决定穿我最喜欢的裙子去派对，虽然有点太隆重了，但它让我感觉非常自信。
sentences.scene: 为了心情而穿搭

sentences.english: He wore a white shirt.
sentences.chinese: 他穿了一件白衬衫。
sentences.scene: 简单描述某人的穿着

sentences.english: I spilled coffee on my shirt right before the important meeting started.
sentences.chinese: 就在重要会议开始前，我把咖啡洒到了衬衫上。
sentences.scene: 发生尴尬的意外

sentences.english: For the school photo, my mom made me wear a button-down shirt that was so stiff and uncomfortable, I couldn't wait to change out of it.
sentences.chinese: 拍学校照片时，我妈非让我穿一件硬邦邦的扣子衬衫，特别不舒服，我迫不及待想换掉它。
sentences.scene: 回忆被家长摆布的拍照经历

sentences.english: Grab your coat. Let's go.
sentences.chinese: 拿上外套，我们走。
sentences.scene: 出门前干脆利落的提醒

sentences.english: I need a new winter coat because my old one has a huge hole in the pocket.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一件新的冬衣，因为旧的这件口袋破了个大洞。
sentences.scene: 考虑换掉破旧的冬季外套

sentences.english: As soon as I stepped outside, I regretted not wearing a thicker coat because the wind was freezing and I had a twenty-minute walk ahead.
sentences.chinese: 我刚踏出门就后悔没穿厚外套，因为寒风刺骨，我还得走二十分钟呢。
sentences.scene: 出门瞬间就被冻得后悔

sentences.english: She bought a blue dress.
sentences.chinese: 她买了一条蓝裙子。
sentences.scene: 分享购物成果

sentences.english: I really love that dress you wore to the wedding. It looked amazing on you.
sentences.chinese: 我特别喜欢你在婚礼上穿的那条裙子，特别好看。
sentences.scene: 真诚地称赞朋友

sentences.english: My little sister wears her princess dress every single day, spinning around and pretending she's at a royal ball.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹每天都穿她的公主裙，转着圈假装自己在皇家舞会上。
sentences.scene: 形容小女孩的天真可爱

sentences.english: Which one do you want?
sentences.chinese: 你想要哪一个？
sentences.scene: 让孩子在两样东西间做选择

sentences.english: Which movie should we watch tonight? We have three great options.
sentences.chinese: 今晚我们看哪部电影？有三个不错的选择。
sentences.scene: 家人一起选电影看

sentences.english: I can never decide which flavor of ice cream to get when there are so many choices, so I usually end up just getting vanilla.
sentences.chinese: 冰淇淋口味太多的时候，我总也决定不了选哪个，所以通常最后就只点个香草的。
sentences.scene: 在冰淇淋店的选择困难症

sentences.english: Spring is my favorite season.
sentences.chinese: 春天是我最喜欢的季节。
sentences.scene: 表达对季节的偏爱

sentences.english: The rainy season just started, so we should expect a lot of storms this month.
sentences.chinese: 雨季刚刚开始，所以这个月估计会有很多暴风雨。
sentences.scene: 提醒朋友天气变化

sentences.english: I love the holiday season because everyone seems a little bit kinder and the whole city lights up with decorations.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢节日季，因为那时每个人都好像更友善一点，整座城市也被装饰得灯火通明。
sentences.scene: 抒发对节日季节的喜爱

sentences.english: I really love winter.
sentences.chinese: 我非常喜欢冬天。
sentences.scene: 看到初雪时的感叹

sentences.english: Winter in Chicago is no joke; it gets so cold that your face hurts.
sentences.chinese: 芝加哥的冬天可不是闹着玩的，冷得脸都疼。
sentences.scene: 分享某地严冬的感受

sentences.english: Last winter, we had so much snow that school was cancelled for three days, and we spent the whole time building an igloo in the backyard.
sentences.chinese: 去年冬天下雪太大，学校取消了三天课，我们整个儿就在后院建了个冰屋。
sentences.scene: 回忆雪假中的快乐

sentences.english: Look, it's starting to snow!
sentences.chinese: 看，开始下雪了！
sentences.scene: 发现窗外飘起雪花时的惊喜

sentences.english: The first snow of the year always feels so magical and quiet.
sentences.chinese: 每年的第一场雪总是感觉如此奇妙又安静。
sentences.scene: 分享初雪带来的美好感受

sentences.english: We woke up to fresh snow covering everything, and it was so peaceful outside that we just sat by the window with hot chocolate for an hour.
sentences.chinese: 我们醒来时新雪覆盖了一切，外面如此宁静，我们就坐在窗边喝着热巧克力，待了整整一个小时。
sentences.scene: 享受雪后清晨的静谧

sentences.english: Let's get together sometime soon.
sentences.chinese: 我们最近找个时间聚聚吧。
sentences.scene: 和老朋友通完电话时提议

sentences.english: We're having a small family get-together on Saturday. You should come.
sentences.chinese: 我们星期六有个小型家庭聚会，你也来吧。
sentences.scene: 热情邀请朋友参加家庭聚会

sentences.english: Even though we're all busy with jobs and kids now, we still find time to get together at least once a month for dinner and to catch up on life.
sentences.chinese: 尽管我们现在都忙于工作和孩子，但依然会每个月至少找时间聚一次，吃个饭，聊聊近况。
sentences.scene: 老友维系感情的固定聚会

sentences.english: I can't wait for spring.
sentences.chinese: 我等不及春天到来了。
sentences.scene: 漫长的冬天里的期盼

sentences.english: The flowers start to bloom and the trees turn green when spring arrives.
sentences.chinese: 春天来临时，花儿开始绽放，树木也变绿了。
sentences.scene: 描绘春天到来的景象

sentences.english: Spring is the perfect time to clean out the garage and get rid of all the stuff we never use.
sentences.chinese: 春天是清理车库、扔掉所有我们不用的东西的最佳时机。
sentences.scene: 计划春季大扫除

sentences.english: Summer is way too hot.
sentences.chinese: 夏天实在太热了。
sentences.scene: 高温天里的抱怨

sentences.english: We go to my grandparents' lake house every summer for a whole week.
sentences.chinese: 我们每年夏天都会去爷爷奶奶的湖边小屋待上整整一个星期。
sentences.scene: 分享每年夏天的固定行程

sentences.english: My best summer memories are from camp, where we roasted marshmallows over the fire and swam in the lake every single day.
sentences.chinese: 我最美好的夏天回忆都来自夏令营，我们每天围在篝火边烤棉花糖，在湖里游泳。
sentences.scene: 怀念夏令营的快乐时光

sentences.english: Autumn leaves are so beautiful.
sentences.chinese: 秋天的叶子真美。
sentences.scene: 踩在落叶上时感叹

sentences.english: I like to go hiking in autumn when the weather is cool and dry.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在秋天去远足，那时天气凉爽干燥。
sentences.scene: 描述最喜欢的秋季户外活动

sentences.english: Autumn is my favorite time of year because I can wear cozy sweaters, drink pumpkin spice lattes, and just enjoy the crisp air.
sentences.chinese: 秋天是我一年中最爱的时节，因为我可以穿舒适的毛衣，喝南瓜拿铁，享受那清爽的空气。
sentences.scene: 细数热爱秋天的种种理由

sentences.english: I need a new T-shirt.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一件新T恤。
sentences.scene: 发现衣柜里缺少基本款

sentences.english: He was just wearing jeans and a white T-shirt, but he looked really cool.
sentences.chinese: 他只穿着牛仔裤和白T恤，但看起来非常酷。
sentences.scene: 描述别人简约好看的穿搭

sentences.english: I have this old band T-shirt from a concert I went to ten years ago, and even though it's full of holes, I can't bring myself to throw it out.
sentences.chinese: 我有一件十年前去看演唱会买的旧乐队T恤，虽然它现在满是洞洞，但我就是舍不得扔掉。
sentences.scene: 一件满是回忆的旧T恤

sentences.english: Fall is my favorite season.
sentences.chinese: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。
sentences.scene: 和朋友聊到天气时的感慨

sentences.english: The leaves change into beautiful red and orange colors in the fall.
sentences.chinese: 秋天叶子会变成美丽的红色和橙色。
sentences.scene: 看到秋叶变色时的描述

sentences.english: Every fall, my family goes apple picking at a farm nearby, and we come home with bags of fresh apples to make pie and cider.
sentences.chinese: 每个秋天，我们全家都会去附近农场摘苹果，然后带着成袋的新鲜苹果回家，做苹果派和苹果酒。
sentences.scene: 全家人的秋日摘苹果传统

sentences.english: A leaf fell on my head.
sentences.chinese: 一片叶子掉在了我头上。
sentences.scene: 走在树下发生的小趣事

sentences.english: The ground was completely covered with yellow and red leaves after the storm.
sentences.chinese: 暴风雨过后，地面完全被黄色和红色的树叶覆盖了。
sentences.scene: 雨后落叶满地的景象

sentences.english: I found a perfectly shaped maple leaf on my walk and pressed it inside my book to use as a bookmark.
sentences.chinese: 我散步时发现一片形状完美的枫叶，就把它压在书里做书签了。
sentences.scene: 收集秋叶做成自然书签

sentences.english: I lost one glove again.
sentences.chinese: 我又丢了一只手套。
sentences.scene: 冬天常丢手套的烦恼

sentences.english: It's so cold outside that my fingers hurt. I need to find my gloves.
sentences.chinese: 外面冷得我手指疼，我得找到我的手套。
sentences.scene: 天寒地冻时需要手套保暖

sentences.english: My fingers were completely freezing while I waited for the bus, until I finally found my gloves buried at the very bottom of my bag.
sentences.chinese: 等公交时我的手指都快冻僵了，最后终于在我包的最底下找到了手套。
sentences.scene: 寒冷中等车翻包找手套

sentences.english: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
sentences.chinese: 我吃完早饭，然后去上学了。
sentences.scene: 简单叙述早上的流程

sentences.english: First, finish your homework, and then you can go out and play with your friends.
sentences.chinese: 先把作业做完，然后你就可以出去和朋友们玩了。
sentences.scene: 家长给孩子设定做事顺序

sentences.english: We walked around the city all day, got completely lost, and then we found this tiny restaurant in a back alley that had the most amazing pasta I've ever eaten.
sentences.chinese: 我们在城里逛了一整天，彻底迷路了，然后在一个小巷子里发现了一家超小的餐馆，那里的意面是我吃过最好吃的。
sentences.scene: 讲述意外的美食发现
